key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:170A
name: stub_return_only
description: A bare return in the vector library with no memory access, library calls or hardware register use. It does no work for its callers.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1716
name: unpack_vector_record_words
description: Reads a packed vector record from the object state, takes a bit shift from one of its fields and rotates 16-bit words by that amount into two work buffers. Other branches fill the buffers from fixed bit patterns.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:178C
name: write_shifted_rows_with_mask
description: Copies source words shifted by a bit count into two consecutive output words per row, pads the rest of each row with zero words and writes the inverted OR of the row as a mask word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:17BE
name: fill_alternating_bit_planes
description: Fills two long-word arrays with alternating one-bit and zero-bit patterns derived from two object state bytes, with a parity flag choosing the phase. The loop count comes from a record field.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:17D0
name: build_bitplane_mask_pairs
description: Walks a count of bits from two object state bytes and writes each bit combination as a pair of long words into two arrays. Mode flags pick between alternate mask sets.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:185A
name: select_long_pairs_by_bits
description: Walks a bit word and stores one of two long-word pairs per bit into two arrays, then copies the last pair into the object state and sets a state byte to a marker value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:185E
name: select_long_pairs_by_byte
description: Walks the bits of a byte and stores one of two long-word pairs per bit into two arrays, then copies the last pair into the object state and sets a state byte to a marker value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1892
name: load_scaled_bitmap_header
description: Finds the bitmap record for the current object, stores its plane size, row padding and flags in the object state, and scales the width and height when a scale factor applies.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:18BC
name: prepare_scaled_bitmap_placement
description: Reads a bitmap header from a record, stores its size and flags in the object state and scales the width and height. It fails when a scaled size becomes zero, otherwise it computes a clipped origin and calls two library routines to place the bitmap.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1914
name: store_scaled_placement_rect
description: Fails when the scaled size is zero. Otherwise it stores the placement rectangle and a centred origin into the object state, then calls two library routines to draw it.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1952
name: store_centred_placement_rect
description: Stores the placement rectangle and a centred origin for the object into its state, then calls two library routines to draw it. It returns success unless the drawing path reports otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:19AA
name: draw_placement_if_visible
description: Optionally recomputes the placement origin through a library call, then unless a clip flag is set stores the placement fields and calls two library routines to draw the object.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:19D4
name: compute_clipped_centred_placement
description: Computes the placement of an object from its scale and centre offsets and fails when the scaled size is zero. Record flags select between combined and separate scaling before the result is stored in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A2E
name: compute_ratio_scaled_placement
description: Derives a size from the ratio of two dimensions, adjusts the origin for negative extents and stores the placement fields in the object state. It fails when the flag combination does not match and otherwise calls two library routines to draw.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A3C
name: compute_scaled_placement_rect
description: Derives the width from a ratio of two dimensions when a flag is set, adjusts the origin for negative extents and stores the placement fields in the object state, then calls two library routines to draw.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A7E
name: stub_return_zero
description: A routine that only returns zero, with no work, no memory access and no library calls.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1A82
name: build_index_table_with_flags
description: Clears four state longs and a counter, then fills a table from a record's 16-bit offsets, either copied directly or relocated against a base address depending on a flag. It then removes repeated entries and stores the surviving count in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AC0
name: relocate_index_table_and_dedupe
description: Adds a base address to each nonzero 16-bit offset in one table, then scans a second table and removes entries that repeat an earlier value, storing the surviving count and stride in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AE4
name: collect_unique_index_entries
description: Scans a table of index values and, for each value, marks later equal entries as removed while recording the surviving values into a second table. It stores the final count and stride into the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AF0
name: compact_unique_index_list
description: Scans a second index table, recording each value once and marking repeats as removed, then stores the surviving count and stride into the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B18
name: clip_vertical_placement_rect
description: Tests whether a placement rectangle overlaps the clip bounds of a record and fails when it lies outside. Otherwise it clips the top and bottom edges, adjusts the object state heights and clears two state fields.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B8A
name: stub_return_zero
description: A routine that only returns zero, with no work, no memory access and no library calls.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B8E
name: prepare_scaled_row_descriptors
description: Computes the source step, horizontal scale and bit shift for each row of a scaled bitmap from the object state, and stores the per-row descriptors in its work table. It calls two library routines to output the rows.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1BCE
name: compute_scaled_bitmap_steps
description: Derives scale steps from two dimensions by division, combines them with the object origin and clip offsets, and stores the start position and fraction in the object state. It reports whether anything was drawn.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1BF0
name: compute_scaled_steps_with_flip
description: Derives scale steps and origin offsets by division like its neighbours, but flips the vertical offset when a record flag is set before storing them in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1C54
name: walk_scaled_bitmap_rows
description: Walks the rows of a bitmap through its row table, stepping through scaled source positions and storing per-row start offsets in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1C98
name: write_row_bit_offset_table
description: Accumulates a scaled step across a count of columns, then writes each row's byte offset and bit position into a table of word pairs. The leftover column count is stored in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1CA6
name: write_row_offset_mask_table
description: Accumulates a scaled step like its neighbours and writes each row's byte offset together with a masked bit position into a table of word pairs. The leftover column count is stored in the object state.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1CE0
name: setup_blitter_row_geometry
description: Splits a width into a bit shift and a count of 16-bit words, stores these and related row values in the object state, waits for the blitter to be free and then calls two library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1D64
name: pack_source_bits_into_words
description: Reads source bytes through an offset table, extracts selected bits with a shift and packs them into 16-bit words that are written to the output row table.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1DF0
name: advance_bitmap_row_pointer
description: Steps through columns and rows, advancing a source pointer by the row stride and calling a library routine per row group until the column counter ends.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1DF8
name: combine_bitplane_rows_into_buffer
description: Walks a table of row offsets and combines bitplane data from the source into the work buffer, copying or ORing according to the object flags. It calls two library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E34
name: or_rows_into_mask_buffers
description: ORs source rows into the output buffers through tables of row offsets, with a separate pass when the object flags are clear.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E88
name: clear_mask_rows_from_buffer
description: Clears bits in the output rows by ANDing them with inverted source words, walking a table of row offsets and skipping zero entries.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E96
name: clear_or_rows_by_index
description: Walks a table of row offsets, ORing source words into output rows when the entry matches the current column and clearing bits from the output otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EA6
name: or_rows_with_index_table
description: Walks an index table and ORs or masks long-word rows into the output buffer, where a zero entry ends the list and a matching index selects the source row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1ED2
name: clear_mask_long_rows
description: Clears bits in long-word output rows by ANDing them with inverted source long words, walking a table of row offsets.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EE0
name: clear_or_long_rows_indexed
description: Walks a table of row offsets over long-word rows, ORing source longs into output rows on a match and clearing bits from the output otherwise.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EF0
name: copy_or_zero_long_rows
description: Fills each output row with either a copied source row of long words or zeros, chosen by a row index table and the object's count fields.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F18
name: copy_or_zero_word_rows
description: Writes each output row as zero words or as a copied source row of words, chosen by a row index table.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F24
name: fill_zero_then_copy_words
description: Fills output rows with zero words where the index table marks them empty and copies word rows from the source otherwise, using the object's row counts.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F40
name: zero_long_then_copy_rows
description: Zeroes a run of long words, then writes each output row as zeros or a copied source row of words according to a row index table.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F4C
name: blit_shifted_rows_with_mask
description: Copies a block of source rows into the output buffer at a bit offset, combining each row with its mask and handling the leading and trailing partial words. It calls one library routine per row group.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F90
name: blit_shifted_rows_inverse_mask
description: Variant of the shifted row copier that makes a second mask pass, combining source rows into the output with an inverted mask on the leading word.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1FEE
name: blit_rows_using_hardware_blitter
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, sets up row sizes and bit shifts, and dispatches to one of several row copy routines according to the object's flags. It calls eight library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:20D0
name: clear_or_shifted_long_rows
description: Clears the destination bits for each shifted source word, ORs the shifted source into long-word rows and advances along the row until its count is used up.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2114
name: clear_or_shifted_word_rows
description: Clears the destination bits for each shifted source word, ORs the shifted source into word rows and advances along the row until its count is used up.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:212A
name: clear_or_split_long_rows
description: Clears and then ORs shifted source words into long-word output rows, splitting each shift across the high and low halves of a long where needed.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2158
name: or_shifted_word_rows
description: ORs a shifted source row into word output rows, carrying the bits that fall off each shift into the next word, and moves on to the next row group.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:216C
name: or_shifted_long_rows
description: ORs a shifted source row into long-word output rows, carrying the bits that fall off each shift into the next word, and moves on to the next row group.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:219E
name: blit_masked_row_group
description: Copies masked row groups into the output with a bit shift taken from the object state, clipping rows against the row count and advancing the source and destination pointers. It calls three library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:21E8
name: clear_or_right_shifted_longs
description: Clears and then ORs right-shifted source words into long-word output rows, handling the carry from the high word of each row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2228
name: clear_or_right_shifted_words
description: Clears and then ORs right-shifted source words into word output rows, handling the carry from the high word of each row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2242
name: clear_right_shifted_long_rows
description: Clears bits of long-word output rows wherever a right-shifted source word has bits set, handling the row remainder. It calls two library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:226E
name: or_right_shifted_word_rows
description: ORs right-shifted source words into word output rows, advancing through each row and the row count of the object.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2286
name: or_right_shifted_long_rows
description: ORs right-shifted source words into long-word output rows, advancing through each row and the row count of the object.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:22B6
name: zero_rows_then_clear_masked
description: Zeroes output rows that the index table marks empty and clears bits from the remaining rows where a mask applies, using the object's row counts. It calls four library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:22E8
name: clear_or_word_rows_strided
description: For each pair of word rows, clears destination bits matching a mask row and ORs the source row in, advancing by a stride and repeating across the row count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2306
name: clear_masked_word_rows
description: Clears destination words wherever the mask row has bits set, walking rows with a stride and a count taken from the object's row fields.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:230E
name: clear_masked_word_column_rows
description: Clears destination words in a column of rows wherever the mask has bits set, advancing by a row stride and a count taken from the object's row fields. It calls two library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2326
name: or_word_rows_with_stride
description: Walks word rows and ORs source words into the destination, advancing by a row stride until the object's row count is used up.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:232E
name: or_word_rows_by_index
description: Walks a row index table and ORs source words into matching word output rows, advancing by a stride across the row count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:234C
name: zero_word_rows_by_index
description: Writes zero words into output rows wherever the index table marks them empty, advancing by a stride across the object's row count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2362
name: copy_word_rows_by_index
description: Copies source words into output word rows along an index table, advancing by separate strides for rows and columns.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2378
name: zero_word_columns_by_stride
description: Zeroes word columns of output rows across the object's row count, stepping by a row stride and handling trailing rows from the index table.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2380
name: zero_word_rows_by_stride
description: Clears word rows across the object's row count, stepping by a row stride.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:239C
name: shift_byte_rows_with_carry
description: Shifts rows of byte data one bit at a time, carrying the bits that fall off each row into the next and applying the mask sign bit. It uses the object's row counts.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:23E8
name: clear_or_byte_rows_strided
description: For each pair of byte rows, clears destination bits matching a mask row and ORs the source row in, advancing by a stride across the row count.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2406
name: clear_masked_byte_rows
description: Clears destination bytes wherever the mask row has bits set, walking rows with a stride taken from the object's row fields.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:240E
name: clear_masked_byte_column_rows
description: Clears destination bytes in a column of rows wherever the mask has bits set, advancing by a row stride. It calls two library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2426
name: or_byte_rows_with_stride
description: ORs source bytes into destination byte rows, advancing by a row stride until the object's row count is used up.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:242E
name: or_byte_column_rows
description: ORs source bytes into a column of destination byte rows, advancing by a row stride. It calls two library routines.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf:libs/vector.library:0:244C
name: setup_blitter_shifted_copy
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its first and last word masks, shift and modulo registers from the row geometry, then starts a blit of the row group through a library routine.

name: blit_rows_with_pointer_setup

key: Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a].adf +$38640 run at $C156A8 (96 bytes, matched to executed PCs):0:0008
name: follow_chain_then_call_entry
description: Follows a chain of pointers until it reaches a zero link, then calls the routine stored at the end of the chain. It calls a library-vector stub after one short adjustment.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:0000
name: run_program_entry_point
description: Finds the current task, clears a return-message flag, calls the main routine and then runs a short cleanup, returning the main routine's result. It makes operating system message calls through the exec library.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:0070
name: load_scores_then_run_loop
description: Opens the DOS library, opens and reads the score file named in the text, decodes the loaded data with an XOR key, then runs the per-frame routines for titles, shots, map, bobs, scan, audio and score display.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:02CC
name: draw_title_screen_blits
description: Draws the title screen by programming the blitter for graphic blits and calling text and control routines. It compares values against executable-hunk type codes, which suggests loader or relocation work.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:1746
name: update_lives_and_score_table
description: Walks a table of packed nibbles, accumulating them into two counters and calling text and life or smart-item routines as the values change. It also sets the four audio channel pointers.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:21A2
name: draw_text_string_to_planes
description: Walks a list of 16-bit indices until a sentinel, and for each index copies eight font bytes into three bitplane buffers, advancing a running offset. The first and third planes are written only when a flag bit allows it.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:2208
name: service_sound_channels
description: Updates the audio DMA control and channel registers, decrements per-channel counters and loads the next sound sample into a channel when its current one has finished or a higher-priority request exists.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:2380
name: reset_sound_then_service
description: Clears the current sound request, records the last sound from a channel table, and then passes control to the sound-channel service routine.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:238C
name: spawn_next_wave_entry
description: Counts down a wave timer and, when it expires, reads the next level table byte, writes a new enemy list entry, sets its flag and initialises its fields from a counter. It clears an entry when a map blow pause applies.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:25AA
name: blit_bob_list
description: Walks a linked list of bob descriptors, programming the blitter's source, destination and mask registers for each entry, waiting for the blitter to be idle, starting the blit and marking the entry as done.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:26BC
name: configure_scanline_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be free and writes control words and pointers into a blitter control block to set up a scanline copy, with a second blit configured from a table entry when a flag applies.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:27BC
name: draw_enemy_icons_and_ship
description: Walks the enemy list and, for each active entry, computes its screen offset, picks shifted icon bytes from tables and ORs them into bitplane buffers while setting collision bytes. It then draws the player ship by combining shifted masks into three bitplanes.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:291A
name: draw_scrolling_map_rows
description: Computes a vertical scroll offset from the map's horizontal position and, when the space flag is clear, programs the blitter and copies fifteen map entries, calculating source and destination addresses from map tables for each.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:29DE
name: fire_player_shots
description: Scans the laser list for free slots and, when a fire control bit is set, starts a new shot at the ship's position and sets the shot sound. It then updates the active laser entries.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:2B94
name: update_ship_motion
description: Updates the ship's vertical position, velocity and thrust from the control flags, clamps the values, computes a map offset and image index, writes thrust to an audio register and stores the ship's coordinates through a pointer. It calls two control routines.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:2D6C
name: decode_control_input_flags
description: Reads a 16-bit input word through a pointer and decodes it into a control value and facing direction. It sets a firing flag from the fire-button bit and updates the facing variable when it changes.

key: defender (1994)(ratsoft)/Defender (1994)(Ratsoft).adf:Defender:0:2E24
name: decode_keyboard_control_keys
description: Tests a table of key press bytes and sets a control bit for each pressed key, and calls a routine to update the smart counter when a smart key is pressed.
